name: MacButners Coffee ,Pies and Dutch Kroketten
address: 1 Waterstone Junction, Main Service Rd, Sedgefield, 6573, South Africa
description_short: Cosy Sedgefield spot serving hearty Dutch kroketten, fresh pies, and excellent coffee at honest prices.
description_long:
Tucked into Waterstone Junction on Sedgefield's main service road, MacButners brings a slice of Dutch comfort food to the Garden Route. This friendly, no-fuss spot has built a loyal following for its authentic kroketten — crispy, golden croquettes filled with creamy ragout — alongside freshly baked pies and proper coffee that keeps locals coming back.

The menu keeps things simple and satisfying, with traditional Dutch snacks sitting comfortably alongside South African favourites. Whether you're grabbing a quick bite on your way through or settling in for a leisurely coffee break, the warm service and home-style cooking make it feel like a neighbourhood gem. Perfect for a budget-friendly breakfast or lunch stop that doesn't compromise on flavour or quality.
